baseline_luk.title: VCP / 3C breakout (Luk exits)
baseline_luk.blurb: Buy strong S&P names that just broke out of a tight base. Cut if price falls through the base floor. If it runs to ~3× risk, sell a little, then trail the rest with the 9-day EMA. Idle cash sits in SPY.
